apps.title: Apps
apps.subtitle: Run apps (Node/Next-SSR/Go/Python) — Lamund manages the process + HTTPS.
apps.domainHint: Point the domain to this server. HTTPS is automatic.
apps.commandHint: Run in the app folder. Lamund injects {port} — the app must listen there. Upload code via Deploy .zip on the site.
apps.emptyHint: Create your first app — deploy your code and Lamund runs & watches the process.
apps.deleteConfirm: Delete app {domain}? The process is stopped & the domain released.
apps.envHint: Environment variables — injected into the process (& build). Stored on the server.

users.subtitle: Manage accounts, roles, MFA & quotas.
users.hasResources: User still owns sites/apps — move or delete them first.
users.cantDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.

siteForm.editSubtitle: Change the site type or target. HTTPS stays automatic.
siteForm.addSubtitle: Point the domain to this server, then Lamund handles HTTPS.
siteForm.staticDesc: Serve HTML/CSS/JS files from a folder
siteForm.proxyDesc: Forward to an app on a local port
siteForm.domainEditHint: The domain can't be changed — delete and recreate if needed.
siteForm.domainAddHint: The domain must already point (A/AAAA) to this server's IP.
siteForm.siteFilesHint: Lamund sets up a managed folder automatically. Once the site is created, open its detail and {deployZip} — no need to touch server paths.
siteForm.upstreamHint: Only loopback addresses (127.0.0.1) are allowed for security.

siteDetail.deployHint: Upload your site as a {zip} (e.g. the contents of the {dist} folder). Old files are fully replaced.
siteDetail.filesGitReadonly: This site is git-managed — files are read-only here. Edit in the repo and redeploy; manual changes would be overwritten.
siteDetail.routingHint: Rules are checked {topToBottom} — the first match wins. Example: {api} → proxy to a local backend, the rest ({root}) → static files.
siteDetail.spaTitle: Fall back to index.html for Vue/React/Next export
siteDetail.cacheTitle: Cache responses to speed things up
siteDetail.noTraffic: No traffic recorded for this domain yet.
siteDetail.deleteConfirm: Delete site {domain}? This action can't be undone.
siteDetail.connectHint: Link this site to a Git repo. Every deploy fetches the latest code — the site becomes git-managed.
siteDetail.connectBuildHint: Leave empty for a plain static repo. Set it (e.g. npm run build) for SPA/framework builds.
siteDetail.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this repository? The last deployed files stay in place; the site goes back to manual/zip management.
siteDetail.dropHint: Drag & drop a .zip here, or click to browse
siteDetail.autoDeployHint: Redeploy automatically on every git push via a GitHub webhook.
siteDetail.webhookSetup: In your GitHub repo → Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook: paste the URL, content type application/json, paste the secret, event: just the push event.
siteDetail.regenConfirm: Regenerate the secret? The old one stops working immediately.
siteDetail.connectGithubHint: Connect GitHub to pick or create a repo.
siteDetail.manualUrl: Or enter a repo URL manually
